title: Shopper Support Academy — The Rated-Service Mileage Supplement on Cartwise Shopper Batches
content:
In a mileage dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the rated-service mileage supplement is added to the mileage owed on the paid route. It reads the customer ratings recorded against the batch on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

- **0.40** when the batch carries a **five-star** customer rating and **no rating of two stars or fewer**;
- **0.20** when it carries a five-star rating and **also a rating of two stars or fewer**;
- **nothing** when it carries **no five-star rating**.

## Training questions

**Does a three-star rating reduce the supplement?** No — only ratings of two stars or fewer do. A batch rated five stars and three stars receives 0.40.

**Does a one-star rating alone give anything?** No — without a five-star rating there is no supplement.

**Ratings of which batch?** Only those recorded against this batch.

## Combination table

| Five-star rating against the batch | Rating of 1 or 2 stars against the batch | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 0.40 |
| Yes | Yes | 0.20 |
| No | Any | Nothing |

Hypothetical: mileage owed of 4.40 with ratings of five and four stars becomes 4.80.
